content.reason: Refused on statement fidelity, not on the proof. The Lean development is sound and the kernel accepts its terminal theorem; the Formal Conjectures declaration erdos_522 it discharges is vacuous, because h_unif requires the defaulted volume on a two-point subset of the complex numbers and nothing measurable satisfies it. Proving a statement nothing can fail establishes nothing about Erdos problem 522, which remains unresolved here. The defect is in the benchmark item and is filed upstream as google-deepmind/formal-conjectures#4386; this authority takes no position on the mathematics.
